verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is payment infrastructure for other agents, not an automation builder. Its purchase-intent mandates (decline threshold, effectiveUntilTime) let an agent complete purchases on the user's behalf within pre-authorized limits after one passkey approval. It also confirms payment outcomes and triggers post-purchase actions in real time. The background agent and its scheduling must be built by the developer, though, and the product is still flagged as in development. Missing for 10: a first-party way to create, schedule or manage background automations, evidence of fully unattended recurring runs without per-instruction user authentication, and hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
